## Scope

- create exactly the 45 number-free child issues in canonical catalog order

- reconcile existing #51, #84, #122, #251, #261-#264, #342, and #345 without creating replacements
- reject duplicate planned IDs, operation keys, conflicting titles, missing dependencies, and extra creation slots before mutation

## Stop conditions

Created GitHub issue numbers are never deleted or recycled to hide a partial failure.

## Non-goals

issues.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Support implemented-phase card truth repair before publication
issues.body:
## Summary

#114 is implemented and locally validated, but exact-head review correctly blocks publication because stale lifecycle-card fields remain unrepairable through the current typed implemented-phase routes.

## Reproduction

In `/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-114-durable-history-parent-integration-proof`:

- #114 phase is `implemented` at gen68/digest `2d3ca383c466163eb34d6961993f237cc60c5dbac7bca336fabf741d725a4a4a`.
- Product/proof validation passes:
  - `python3 .csdlc/prepared/issues/114/validate_preparation_bundle.py`
  - `python3 adl/tools/validate_v092_durable_history_parent_integration.py`
  - `cargo test --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --test durable_conversation_history_integration -- --nocapture`
  - `cargo clippy --manifest-path adl-runtime-kernel/Cargo.toml --test durable_conversation_history_integration -- -D warnings`
  - `csdlc-validate --root /Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-issue-114-durable-history-parent-integration-proof issue --issue 114`
- Exact review R2 fails because card truth still says preparation/ready-only:
  - `.csdlc/issues/114/cards/stp.md` task boundary says stop before bind/publication/PR/merge/closeout.
  - `.csdlc/issues/114/cards/stp.md` non-goals still include binding and editing Runtime/test code.
  - `.csdlc/issues/114/cards/spp.md` summary still says ready/unbound and execution stops before bind.
  - `.csdlc/issues/114/cards/sor.md` status remains `pre_phase`.

Typed attempted repairs showed the gap:

- `set_field(task_boundary)` on STP in implemented phase fails with `stp mutation is not allowed during implemented`.
- `correct_plan_summary_after_recovery` requires a recovery transition from reviewed/published/merge_ready to implemented, so it cannot repair an implemented issue recovered from an assignment-only review failure.
- `advance_status` for SOR is not authorized in implemented phase, so `pre_phase` cannot become ready/complete through the owner route.
- `replace_planning_collection(non_goals)` is not authorized for STP in implemented phase.

## Required outcome

Provide a bounded typed v2 operation or recovery route that lets an implemented, pre-publication issue repair stale lifecycle-card truth after review recovery without hand-editing rendered cards or weakening review/publication guards.

## Acceptance criteria

- Implemented-phase typed repair can update STP task boundary or equivalent publication-truth field when review/publication/readiness/terminal truth is cleared.
- Implemented-phase typed repair can update STP non-goals or equivalent scope truth when stale text contradicts implemented proof.
- Implemented-phase typed repair can update SPP summary after assignment/review recovery for an issue that never reached reviewed/published.
- Implemented-phase typed repair can advance or otherwise truthfully normalize SOR card status before fresh review/publication.
- Guards still reject mutation after reviewed/published unless the supported review recovery path has cleared review/publication truth.
- Regression test covers the #114-shaped sequence: implemented issue, assigned review, recovered failed/stale assignment, supported card truth repairs, fresh review assignment possible.

## Non-goals

- Hand-editing generated cards.
- Weakening publication guard or allowing publication without current exact-head review.
- Broad lifecycle redesign.

## Blocking impact

Blocks #114 publication and therefore #116/#117/#110 readiness in WP-18C.

issues.title: [v0.92.1][WP-24A] Podcast Studio first ten episodes
issues.body:
Canonical successor for [danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5845](https://github.com/danielbaustin/agent-design-language/issues/5845).

## Migration semantics

- `replaces`: danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5845 as active current-repository issue authority.
- The archived source body is preserved below without claiming implementation, review, publication, merge, or terminal progress.
- Continue all future planning and lifecycle work only on this current-repository successor.

## Archived source issue body

## Summary

Execute **WP-24A** for v0.92 within this issue's approved design and ownership boundary.

Create and validate ten review-ready production packages using retained Podcast Studio v2 proof and the approved route/storage decision. Complete episode checkpoints may land incrementally, but a checkpoint must include the full package contract for every episode it labels complete. Do not close WP-24A until all ten packages and the integration proof are complete.

## Required Outcome

All first ten episodes are complete review-ready production packages, not topic or schema placeholders.

## Episode Package Contract

Each complete episode includes canonical episode metadata, source packet, script, transcript, show notes, final MP3 and archive audio with manifests, QA report, guest metadata, artwork and ID3 metadata, RSS enclosure record, redaction report, and editorial/audio review.

Shared audio routes are allowed when the episode metadata, audio manifest, and enclosure record bind the exact paths, byte counts, and SHA-256 digests.

An incremental checkpoint:

- includes the complete package for each episode it claims;
- passes the applicable positive and negative validators;
- uses `Part of danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5845`, not a closing keyword;
- leaves this parent issue open.

## Deliverables

- Ten complete episode directories
- Ten final MP3 and archive-audio artifacts with manifests
- Validated feed and enclosure records
- Audio, redaction, guest, metadata, playback, and listen-check QA
- Exact-head editorial/audio review

## Dependencies

- #5819 canonical naming/link truth
- #3223 and #3256 retained Podcast Studio v2 proof
- Agent Logic route/storage decision

## Owned Paths

## Validation And Proof

- Prove complete package contents, audio manifests, embedded ID3 metadata, and feed/enclosure parity.
- Reject missing audio or package artifacts, digest and metadata mismatch, local feed paths, guest-acceptance overclaims, unsafe text, and publication overclaims.
- Retain source-SHA-bound platform playback evidence before terminal WP-24A completion.
- Keep deployment, mailbox verification, branded-host configuration, directory submission, and publication under the separate launch authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC-1: All ten episodes contain every required script, audio, transcript, note, metadata, artwork, enclosure, redaction, QA, and review artifact.
- AC-2: Audio digests, duration, sample rate, channels, loudness, peak, ID3/artwork, listen check, and archive records are internally consistent.
- AC-3: Feed/enclosure records match episode specs and reject local paths, drafts, unstable GUIDs, missing bytes, and MIME/duration mismatches.
- AC-4: Guest consent, source rights, credentials, synthetic-voice provenance, and redaction remain truthful and privacy-safe.
- AC-5: Required source-SHA-bound platform playback receipts pass digest-recomputing validation before terminal completion, with no deployment or publication claim.

## Non-Goals

- Deployment or podcast-directory submission
- Mailbox verification
- Branded-host configuration
- Treating historical smoke artifacts as final
- Claiming guest acceptance, live unscripted dialogue, weekly cadence, or a public route without proof
- Article ownership

## Rollback

Restore the previous feed and launch-readiness records, remove only episode packages and playback producers introduced by this issue, and retain rejected audio, redaction, consent, metadata, and playback reports under issue evidence. Rollback must not delete upstream Podcast Studio proof, mutate guest consent records, deploy feed changes, or claim publication.
